selected_evidence.requirement: Key-based SSH authentication required (password auth disabled)
selected_evidence.summary: Added sshd drop-in disabling password/kbd-interactive auth, validated syntax, confirmed via sshd -T the effective config, confirmed no conflicting earlier directive, restarted sshd, and proved live via a rejected password-auth SSH attempt (publickey/gssapi only offered); opsadmin's shadow entry shows locked password (!).
Captured pre-restart boot_id (4cee4ea8-4b8e-4c2f-af1a-3a82b9ec41f4), uptime, and sshd active status as baseline.

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory node-restart protocol: restart acknowledgement and changed boot identity
selected_evidence.summary: Issued a backgrounded systemctl reboot so the ack returned before disconnect; polled through the outage (connection timeouts/reset) until reconnect; boot_id changed to d0bad5ab-aecb-49b4-a936-3b2466695c1b, proving an actual reboot occurred.

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory node-restart protocol: post-restart recovery verification
selected_evidence.summary: After reconnect, confirmed sshd active with key-only auth settings intact, opsadmin user/key/locked-password state intact, and a live SSH password-auth attempt still rejected (publickey/gssapi only).
